_fixtureNote: CONSTRUCTED 2026-10-23. Suggested inputs, weights and thresholds for the RaceLens confidence label (Low/Fair/Good). Weights are design choices (low confidence); the rationale for each input is sourced in research/modelknowledge.md section 14.

sourceAgreement.definition: share of card facts (runner no., barrier, jockey, weight, scratchings) matching across >=2 sources

marketConcentration.definition: top market prob and gap to second; favourites win ~35% overall, clear short favourites far more

modelMarketAgreement.definition: same top pick (0.5) + Spearman rho of rankings (0.5)

formCompleteness.definition: share of runners with >=4 starts and today's distance/condition form

conditionsVolatility.definition: Heavy 8-10, rail >=+6m, strong wind, downgrade during day, late scratchings

dayPatternSupport.direction: up if pattern supports top pick, down if contradicts

formula: C = sum(weight_i * value_i) with volatility entering as (1 - volatility)

expectedPerformance.note: if 'Good' back-tests below 45% top-pick win rate, lower thresholds

displayRule: show the two largest detractors in plain words

evidence.source: github.com/Kelvin1761/Kelvin-Agents gap report (heavy-track top-1 rates noisier)
